about.title: We make visuals that bring in customers.
about.intro: Roby Media is a full-service photo, video and marketing agency. We work with businesses, brands and people all over Romania who want to look good and sell more.
story: We started in video production: weddings, events, films for businesses. We quickly saw that a beautiful video isn't enough if it doesn't reach the right people.
So we added marketing: TikTok, Meta and Google ads, websites built for conversion. Today, the person who writes the script also understands how the ad will run.
For our clients, the result is simple: one partner, one conversation, and content and campaigns that work together.
about.gearIntro: We work with professional gear, maintained and tested before every project.

gear.title: Cameras
gear.text: Cinema and full-frame mirrorless cameras, 4K recording, fast lenses for low light.

gear.title: Drones
gear.text: 4K camera drones with 3-axis stabilisation for aerial video and photography.

gear.title: Lighting
gear.text: Professional LED lights, softboxes and modifiers for indoor and outdoor shoots.

gear.title: Audio
gear.text: Wireless mics, separate recorders and studio microphones for podcasts.

gear.title: Stabilisation
gear.text: Gimbals, sliders and video tripods for smooth camera movement.

gear.title: Post-production
gear.text: Editing workstations, calibrated colour grading, sound design and motion graphics.
